payload.title: File:Dicraeosaurus sattleri Skeletal.svg
payload.description_html:
Skeletal diagram of the Upper Jurassic Tanzanian sauropod dinosaur Dicraeosaurus sattleri. The holotype specimen, "Skelett M," has been used as the main basis for this reconstruction, with unknown regions filled in by other D. sattleri specimens, D. hansemanni, Amargasaurus, and Bajadasaurus.

Key

  •   Known in the holotype
  •   Unknown in the holotype but known in other specimens
  •   Unknown

Scale bar=1 metre (3.3 ft)
